title: Persona Imprinting: code and data
description:
Engine, task bank, persona specifications, analysis scripts and the complete per-run artifacts for all 28 runs reported in Persona Imprinting: Evolved Prompts Inherit the Identity of the Model that Writes Them (Castillo-Sepúlveda, Torres-Yévenes & Lanas-Ocampo, Axis Dynamics SpA).

A genetic algorithm evolves a structured prompt genome over locally served language models. Two of the four genes are authored by the model under study itself, so every act of variation is a transmission event. When that model is conditioned by a persona specification, persona-specific symbolic markers appear in 6 of 6 persona-conditioned runs and 0 of 6 control and ablation runs (Fisher exact p = 0.002, run as the experimental unit). Switching off model-authored gene synthesis removes the effect in every replicate.

Every table and figure in the paper is regenerated here by a named script from logged data. Nothing is withheld or transformed: the persona specifications are published in full. See DATA_AVAILABILITY.md.
